statement: The seed's leader-readiness join gate no longer rejects joiners from a stale leader-metadata view while fresher authoritative evidence exists: on a leader-metadata miss it performs a bounded authoritative re-read of the missing partitions' rows via the already-held authoritativeControlPlaneView (the refreshAuthoritativeRoutingOverlay pattern) before returning LEADER_METADATA_INCOMPLETE. Proven by deterministic red-on-revert tests: a stale-cache/fresh-authoritative scenario admits the joiner after refresh, a genuinely-leaderless scenario still rejects, and no authoritative reads occur on the hit path or the high-frequency probe path.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.

The refresh must be aggregate-bounded (batched or capped across missing partitions), never unbounded per-partition fan-out per join request — CL-012 readiness-read-amplification class; CL-012 guard tests must stay green.

The refresh must be bounded-time and FAIL-OPEN to the current reject when authoritative reads are unavailable (formation circularity: during formation the authoritative path may itself lack the missing leaders — never block or crash the gate).
